touches.text: Tool: a complete primitive. Has users, not an owner. Calls no other Cairn component (stdlib and base only) and owns no state of its own. Lives in cairn/tools/ (17). Its data for a holder lives under that holder: ~/.cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/tools/<tool>/.
Commit often. WHY: so we never wind up with stray files or incomplete work.
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.

Commit: the proofs of the component the ticket changed, since RULE 1 bounds a change to its component. Passing them puts the component in service, yellow: proven where it changed, not yet measured against what depends on it. Akien: "being put in service only requires that it's the best we can do now. only requires 80% trust."
A tool, not a machine, even though it spans several files; the base-most stuff belongs to Cairn.
